picks.title: Make an AI Short Film in Claude | Runway MCP
picks.rationale: A hands-on primary-source workflow: Runway shows how to go from director's notes to storyboards, references, a shot list and multi-shot scenes inside Claude using the Runway MCP. Filmmakers can try it tomorrow.
picks.excerpt: Runway walks through making a complete micro film with Claude and the Runway MCP: director's notes, storyboards, character and location references, a four-scene shot list, then multi-shot scene generation in draft mode.

picks.title: David Ayer to Become a Partner at Ryan Kavanaugh's New Location-Defying AI Company (Exclusive)
picks.rationale: A working director backs ACME AI's 'Grey Box' production method: shoot on a grey stage and generate the locations with AI. Ayer argues this makes many location shoots unnecessary, which would change how productions are planned.
picks.excerpt: Director David Ayer is joining Ryan Kavanaugh's ACME AI as principal and managing partner; its 'Grey Box' tech lets directors shoot on a grey stage and generate locations with AI, which Ayer says makes many location shoots moot.

picks.title: Adobe Gives Sneak Peek at Real-Time Generative AI Video Editing Feature
picks.rationale: Adobe's Project Live Set research sneak generates and edits AI video effects while the footage plays. This is a distinct MAX item from the Premiere Color Mode/MCP release card of 11-11.
picks.excerpt: Adobe's Project Live Set research sneak lets creators generate and edit AI video effects while the footage is playing.

picks.title: AI로 만든 영화·애니메이션 등 64개 작품 공개…콘진원, 콘텐츠 창작 인재 양성 성과 선보여
picks.rationale: A government-backed AI Creator Showcase 2026 screened 64 AI short films and animations to 2,354 visitors. Working directors, including Kim Tae-yeop of 'Lovely Runner', described how they actually use AI when making their work.
picks.excerpt: 문체부·한국콘텐츠진흥원의 'AI 크리에이터 쇼케이스 2026'(11/12-14, 코엑스·메가박스)에서 AI 단편영화·애니메이션 등 64개 프로젝트가 공개됐고 2,354명이 찾았다. '선재 업고 튀어' 김태엽 감독 등이 실제 창작 과정의 AI 활용 경험을 공유했다.

picks.title: Chinese Dubbing Firm Reaps AI Savings, Faces Pricing Pressure
picks.rationale: Concrete production data: Transn has AI-dubbed more than 20,000 microdramas with human review, cutting turnaround to days. Falling per-title prices show what AI localisation is doing to dubbing economics.
picks.excerpt: Chinese language-services integrator Transn has dubbed more than 20,000 microdramas using AI with human review, cutting production time to days, but falling dubbing prices are squeezing it as revenue grows.

dedup.note: The pool had 11 items. Dropped as duplicates: ProVideo Coalition Final Cut Pro 13 / MotionVFX is a likely repeat of the 10-30 RedShark card on the Apple Creator Studio MotionVFX update. ProVideo 'Tool Tip Tuesday' on the Premiere AI Assistant and the No Film School AI Assistant explainer (cluster c4) are more coverage of the Adobe MAX Premiere 2027 release, already carded on 11-11 (RedShark). They are tutorials/explainers with no new release, and 11-17 dropped them for the same reason. Korea Times 'Raphael' review is about the film already featured in the Korea Times card from 11-06; a review is not a new event, and 11-17 dropped it for the same reason. Not picked: the Variety Christopher Hampton interview is commentary only, and aitimes 42762 (Frome AI screening event preview) is minor and would be a second aitimes card. Project Live Set is a MAX research sneak, distinct from the Premiere release card, as the curator brief confirms. It runs 7 days after publication. Diversity: 5 distinct outlets. Cross-section: none of these appear in the brief's cross-section assignments. published_urls.json could not be exact-grepped from this agent (no shell), so the orchestrator should exact-grep all 5 URLs (aitimes by full ?idxno=42753) before roll.
